name: Sterling Greenwoods Limited
about: Sterling Greenwoods Limited engages in the real estate business in India. The company operates in two segments, Resort and Membership, and Real Estate Business. It is also involved in plotted developments and resorts. In addition, the company operates Greenwoods Lake Resort in Ahmedabad. Sterling Greenwoods Limited was founded in 1965 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
